text: Authentication & Security
Authentication
The system should support user authentication using OAuth 2.0 or SAML.
comment: Scope too broad. Need to clarify which identity providers are required. Recommend splitting into separate requirements for OAuth 2.0 and SAML support.
miscellaneous: Comment: Scope too broad. Need to clarify which identity providers are required. Recommend splitting into separate requirements for OAuth 2.0 and SAML support. | Review Status: rejected

text: Users should be able to reset their passwords via email verification.
comment: Missing details on security measures. How is the reset token generated and validated? Need threat model for email-based reset flow.
miscellaneous: Comment: Missing details on security measures. How is the reset token generated and validated? Need threat model for email-based reset flow. | Review Status: rejected

text: Authorization
Users should have different permission levels (e.g., admin, regular user, guest).
comment: Vague requirement. Define specific permission levels and their associated capabilities. See ANF-006 for RBAC implementation details instead.
miscellaneous: Comment: Vague requirement. Define specific permission levels and their associated capabilities. See ANF-006 for RBAC implementation details instead. | Review Status: rejected

text: The application must support data encryption for sensitive information at rest and in transit.
comment: Approved. Implementation should use TLS 1.3+ for transit and AES-256 for at-rest encryption. Reference security architecture document.

text: The system should implement role-based access control (RBAC) with audit logging.
Usability & Responsiveness
The application must be responsive and work seamlessly on desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
The application must be compatible with major web browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge).
The system interface should follow WCAG 2.1 Level AA accessibility standards.
comment: Good requirement. Consider adding specific acceptance criteria for color contrast and keyboard navigation testing.
miscellaneous: Comment: Good requirement. Consider adding specific acceptance criteria for color contrast and keyboard navigation testing. | Review Status: not_reviewed

text: Notifications & Reporting
The system should provide real-time notifications via email, SMS, and in-app alerts.
The system should generate customizable reports based on user activities and system metrics.
Reports must be exportable in PDF, CSV, and Excel formats.
comment: Need to specify performance requirements for large report generation (e.g., timeout limits, file size constraints). Also consider ODS format for compatibility.
miscellaneous: Comment: Need to specify performance requirements for large report generation (e.g., timeout limits, file size constraints). Also consider ODS format for compatibility. | Review Status: not_reviewed

text: Backup & Recovery
The system should have automated backup and recovery mechanisms with daily incremental backups.
comment: arify backup window and potential impact on system performance. What about backup verification and testing procedures?
miscellaneous: Comment: Clarify backup window and potential impact on system performance. What about backup verification and testing procedures? | Review Status: not_reviewed

text: Recovery time objective (RTO) should not exceed 4 hours and recovery point objective (RPO) should not exceed 1 hour.
comment: RTO of 4 hours may be too aggressive for production systems. Recommend risk assessment and cost-benefit analysis. Define failure scenarios covered.
miscellaneous: Comment: RTO of 4 hours may be too aggressive for production systems. Recommend risk assessment and cost-benefit analysis. Define failure scenarios covered. | Review Status: not_reviewed

text: Note: All backups must be encrypted and stored in geographically distributed locations.
Performance & Scalability
The system must support at least 10,000 concurrent users with no performance degradation.
comment: Define 'no degradation' with specific metrics (e.g., response time, throughput). Need load testing plan and baseline measurements.
miscellaneous: Comment: Define 'no degradation' with specific metrics (e.g., response time, throughput). Need load testing plan and baseline measurements. | Review Status: not_reviewed

text: API response time must be under 200ms for 95th percentile requests.
comment: Good SLA target. Need to define measurement methodology and exclude network latency. Consider p99 percentile as well.
miscellaneous: Comment: Good SLA target. Need to define measurement methodology and exclude network latency. Consider p99 percentile as well. | Review Status: not_reviewed

text: The application must implement caching strategies to reduce database load and improve response times.
Compliance & Documentation
The system must comply with GDPR, CCPA, and other applicable data protection regulations.
comment: Broad scope. Need to identify all applicable regulations for each deployment region and create detailed compliance matrix with acceptance criteria.
miscellaneous: Comment: Broad scope. Need to identify all applicable regulations for each deployment region and create detailed compliance matrix with acceptance criteria. | Review Status: not_reviewed
